conflicts.description: McGrath's start date. The 2014-08-01 8-K says the Board 'On July 31, 2014' elected her and appointed her to the LD&C Committee, 'effective as of October 1, 2014'. It is unclear whether 'effective' covers the election or only the committee seat. Her Form 3 event date is 2014-07-31 and every proxy says 'Director since: July 2014', so the start is recorded as 2014-07-31.
Brad Smith's Intuit CEO tenure: the 2023-09-13 8-K says 'January 2008 to January 2019', the 2026 proxy says 'January 2008 to December 2018'. Bio detail only; it doesn't affect his Amazon dates.

open_questions: When Jamie Gorelick became lead (independent) director, and when Rubinstein's lead-director tenure ended, is not disclosed. The 2023 proxy (2023-04-13) names Rubinstein, the 2024 proxy (2024-04-11) Gorelick. Her role is recorded with an unknown start. Rubinstein's past lead-director span (first named 2018-04-18) and Stonesifer's (proxies of 2015-04-24 to 2017-04-12) are undated, so they appear only in membership notes.

Bezos's Executive Chair start day. Filings say 'July 2021' and that he was CEO through 2021-07-04 (Jassy from 2021-07-05). Day precision would be inference, so the role is recorded at month precision.

Kevin Mandia (elected 2026-09-08): no independence determination yet; the 2027 proxy should give it. He sits on the Audit and Security committees, and the 8-K discloses that his sister-in-law is an Amazon employee.

Exact days for pre-2001 or announcement-only starts: Bezos (July 1994, founder), Stonesifer (February 1997, pre-IPO) and Ryder (November 2002; the 2002-11-06 press release says only that he 'has been elected').

Board size: Amazon's filings reviewed state nominee counts (10 in 2020-2021, 11 in 2022-2023, 12 in 2024-2025, 11 in 2026), not an authorized board size. With Mandia, 12 directors are seated as of 2026-10-04. No BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events are recorded.

Committee seats in the 2024-2026 proxy tables are icons, not text. Alexander's 2026 Security membership (no longer chair) and McGrath's 2024 LD&C membership (Cooper chairing) are visible only as icons. Their committees[] rows use their last text bios (2025 and 2023 proxies).

IPO date: the 1997 10-K and Q2 1997 10-Q say the IPO was 'completed' on May 15, 1997, the 424B1 prospectus is dated May 15, 1997 and the registration went effective May 14, 1997. No filing literally says trading began May 15, 1997. ipo_date is set to 1997-05-15 on that basis.

Other-board lists come from Amazon's own bios as of each filing and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Former boards are often named without saying the company is public (public_company_stated_in_source=false).

coverage.method: Roster from the 2026 DEF 14A (filed 2026-04-09) and the 2026-05-22 8-K Item 5.07 (eleven elected; Alexander did not stand). Checked against every filing in the EDGAR submissions feed from 2026-04-09 through 2026-09-24 (latest): the only Item 5.02 8-K is the 2026-09-09 Mandia election; Forms 3/4 (Mandia's Form 3) and both 2026 10-Qs (Item 5) show no other changes.

Every DEF 14A 2019-2026, every 8-K with Item 5.02 (2019-02-04 through 2026-09-09) and every 8-K Item 5.07 (2019-2026) reviewed; departures dated from 8-K 5.02 effective dates or annual-meeting dates. Board on 2020-01-01 = the ten elected at the 2019-05-22 meeting (no Item 5.02 board changes between then and the 2020 proxy).

Only start dates of directors who served on or after 2020-01-01 (from 8-Ks, Forms 3, proxies and the 1997 IPO prospectus). Directors who left before 2020 (e.g., Alberg, Krikorian, Cook, Doerr) are not recorded.
